description:
[measured] Funding carry screener on REALIZED numbers, out of sample: for each coin, the venue
    pair a desk would have put on a week ago (short where funding WAS richest, long where it was
    cheapest, chosen on days 14-7 ago: selection_week_apr) and what that pair then earned from funding
    over the last 7 days (realized_7d_*, negative when the spread reversed) and 30 days, annualized;
    positive_share_7d = share of the week's hours the pair was net positive (0.5 is a coin flip);
    current_spread_apr = the same pair right now; mark_gap_bps = short-venue mark over long-venue
    mark (positive = entry in your favour). Use get_funding_dispersion for the live spread across
    all venues. Everything is gross: before taker fees, basis moves and two margin accounts.
    Not financial advice.
